quote: LLMs can be allowed to autoregressively generate a sequence of labels.
In this work, we investigate how LLMs generate multi-label predictions by analyzing their output distributions in each generation step.
We compute the negative log likelihood (NLL), L1 distance, and example-F1 to evaluate how well the empirical distribution aligns with the LLM-derived distribution.
